title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About Job:

Job Title: Customer Service Representative
Location: Pompano Beach FL (Onsite)
Duration: 03 Months Contract
Pay Rate: $17.00 on W2
Shift Details: Monday thru Friday
From 9 am to 5 pm Saturday to Sunday off

As a Customer Service Representative, you will ensure that we deliver on our promise of outstanding service. You’ll work with customers, business partners and drivers to make sure we are meeting our commitments and delighting our customers at every step of the experience

What your day-to-day will look like:
• Assist customers and business partners via telephone and email
• Handle customer complaints in a calm, professional manner
• Diagnose, assess, and resolve problems or issues
• Monitor progress of delivery routes
• Scan haul-away pods and verify stamps
• Process changes or cancellations to delivery orders

What you’ll need to excel:
At a minimum, you’ll need:
• Experience with Microsoft Office programs such as MS Project, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
It’d be great if you also have:
• High school diploma or equivalent
• 1-year related experience preferably within a call center environment
• Strong customer service skills and the ability to satisfactorily resolve issues
• Solid ability to multitask with exceptional organizational skills
• Ability to thrive under pressure while delivering solutions that exceed customer expectations

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Representative
Location: Bessemer, AL (Onsite)
Job Type: 6 Months Contract
Max Pay Rate: $18.75/hour
Schedule: Shift Details: Sun, Mon, Tues, Wed, Thurs | 9:00am - 6:00pm
                       Sun, Mon, Tues, Wed, Thurs | 9:00am - 8:00pm
                       Fri, Sat, Sun & Mon | 7:00am - 6:00pm
                       Tues, Wed, Thurs, Fri, Sat | 7:00AM - 4:00PM
                       Mon, Thurs, Fri, Sat | 9:00am - 8:00pm

Job Overview

We are seeking a Customer Service Representative to join a fast-paced team supporting customers, business partners, and drivers. In this role, you'll help ensure exceptional customer experiences by resolving issues, coordinating deliveries, and providing timely support via phone and email.

If you're a strong communicator who enjoys problem-solving, multitasking, and working in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer and business partner inquiries via phone and email
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently
  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery-related issues
  • Monitor delivery routes and shipment progress
  • Scan haul-away pods and verify required documentation
  • Process delivery order changes and cancellations
  • Maintain accurate records and provide excellent customer service

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum 1 year of customer service experience, preferably in a call center or logistics environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint; MS Project is a plus)
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Call center experience
  • Transportation, logistics, or supply chain experience
  • Experience handling customer escalations
